original_benchmark.notes: CoT-Control-QA: GPQA (445), HLE (469) and MMLU-Pro (300) questions x 9 CoT instruction types. The paper counts 10,926 instances; the released harness skips the 45 questions without keyword data for the two word-suppression types, which leaves the 10,836 instances it actually runs.

CoT-Control-Agent: SWE-bench Verified (200) and BFCL (150) x 9 instruction types, run with inspect_ai. Adaptable in principle but not adapted in this version: upstream publishes no script from trajectories to the graded table, does not specify how multi-turn reasoning is concatenated, and leaves inspect_ai/inspect_evals unpinned.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity experiments have not been run yet; parity fields are intentionally empty. Proposed parity subset: 675 tasks (25 questions per dataset x 9 instruction types, --split parity).
